entries.text: You see Lasher of the Children.
entries.source_text: You see Lasher of the Children.

entries.text: 你看见大教堂的教徒之一，拉舍尔。
entries.source_text: 你看见大教堂的教徒之一，拉舍尔。

entries.text: I know who you are. You are a wicked, evil man and you must be punished.
entries.source_text: I know who you are. You are a wicked, evil man and you must be punished.

entries.text: 我知道你是谁。你是一个坏事做尽的恶徒，你必须受到惩罚。
entries.source_text: 我知道你是谁。你是一个坏事做尽的恶徒，你必须受到惩罚。

entries.text: 我知道你是是谁。你是一个藏在女人体内的恶魔，你的外壳是不会拯救你的。
entries.source_text: 我知道你是是谁。你是一个藏在女人体内的恶魔，你的外壳是不会拯救你的。

entries.text: I know who you are. Your wickedness precedes you. You send the souls of children to Hades, before they can be cleansed of their perfidy. It is a black evil that you do, and you must be punished for it.
entries.source_text: I know who you are. Your wickedness precedes you. You send the souls of children to Hades, before they can be cleansed of their perfidy. It is a black evil that you do, and you must be punished for it.

entries.text: 我知道你是谁。你的邪恶已经早早地暴露了你。你在教徒们净化自己的背叛前就把他们的灵魂打入了地狱。这是你所犯下的大恶中的大恶，为此你必须受到惩罚。
entries.source_text: 我知道你是谁。你的邪恶已经早早地暴露了你。你在教徒们净化自己的背叛前就把他们的灵魂打入了地狱。这是你所犯下的大恶中的大恶，为此你必须受到惩罚。

entries.text: I know who you are. You are walking death, a plague in human form. Where you step, blood flows like a river. But such iniquities can be ended by a righteous soul!
entries.source_text: I know who you are. You are walking death, a plague in human form. Where you step, blood flows like a river. But such iniquities can be ended by a righteous soul!

entries.text: 我知道你是谁。你是行走的死亡，披着人皮的瘟疫。你的脚踏到哪里，哪里就会血流成河。但是不管你的邪恶多么逆天，它都可以被一个公正的灵魂终结！
entries.source_text: 我知道你是谁。你是行走的死亡，披着人皮的瘟疫。你的脚踏到哪里，哪里就会血流成河。但是不管你的邪恶多么逆天，它都可以被一个公正的灵魂终结！

entries.text: 你竟敢打扰我！难道你不知道我的工作是多重要吗？滚出去！
entries.source_text: 你竟敢打扰我！难道你不知道我的工作是多重要吗？滚出去！

entries.text: 你愚蠢到了用武器对着我。主教的守护在我身上，除了受惩罚我不可能被触碰！
entries.source_text: 你愚蠢到了用武器对着我。主教的守护在我身上，除了受惩罚我不可能被触碰！

entries.text: 我根本不在乎主教的保护。
entries.source_text: 我根本不在乎主教的保护。

entries.text: 聪明难道有错！
entries.source_text: 聪明难道有错！

entries.text: I just want to speak with the man in charge.
entries.source_text: I just want to speak with the man in charge.

entries.text: 我只想和负责人谈谈。
entries.source_text: 我只想和负责人谈谈。

entries.text: 你这个棒子很帅啊！这就是别人为什么叫你“拉舍尔”的原因吗？
entries.source_text: 你这个棒子很帅啊！这就是别人为什么叫你“拉舍尔”的原因吗？

entries.text: Is it true that you enjoy abusing children?
entries.source_text: Is it true that you enjoy abusing children?

entries.text: 你真的以虐待孩子为乐吗？
entries.source_text: 你真的以虐待孩子为乐吗？

entries.text: 你想知道什么是愚蠢？跟我多嘴就是愚蠢，婊子！
entries.source_text: 你想知道什么是愚蠢？跟我多嘴就是愚蠢，婊子！

entries.text: Why you talk so funny?
entries.source_text: Why you talk so funny?

entries.text: 你为什么说话这么滑稽？
entries.source_text: 你为什么说话这么滑稽？

entries.text: Why have you come, initiate? You know that I do not like to be disturbed.
entries.source_text: Why have you come, initiate? You know that I do not like to be disturbed.

entries.text: 你为什么来这，受启蒙的人？你知道我是不喜欢被打扰的。
entries.source_text: 你为什么来这，受启蒙的人？你知道我是不喜欢被打扰的。

entries.text: Forgive me, Father, but I am troubled.
entries.source_text: Forgive me, Father, but I am troubled.

entries.text: 原谅我，我的神父啊，我被深深地困惑着。
entries.source_text: 原谅我，我的神父啊，我被深深地困惑着。

entries.text: I seek the guidance of the Cathedral.
entries.source_text: I seek the guidance of the Cathedral.

entries.text: 我寻求大教堂的引导。
entries.source_text: 我寻求大教堂的引导。

entries.source_text: I抦 here to talk about your treatment of the Children.

entries.text: 我来这是为了和你谈谈虐待孩子的事情。
entries.source_text: 我来这是为了和你谈谈虐待孩子的事情。

entries.text: I just wanted to talk.
entries.source_text: I just wanted to talk.

entries.text: 我只是想谈谈。
entries.source_text: 我只是想谈谈。

entries.text: Nice rod you've got there! Is that why they call you Lasher?
entries.source_text: Nice rod you've got there! Is that why they call you Lasher?

entries.text: 你这个棒子很帅啊！这就是别人为什么叫你拉舍尔的原因吗？
entries.source_text: 你这个棒子很帅啊！这就是别人为什么叫你拉舍尔的原因吗？

entries.text: How would you like to never be disturbed again. I can arrange that!
entries.source_text: How would you like to never be disturbed again. I can arrange that!

entries.text: 你喜欢怎样的方式使自己不再被别人打扰？我能帮你安排这个！
entries.source_text: 你喜欢怎样的方式使自己不再被别人打扰？我能帮你安排这个！

entries.text: I dunno. Why I come? You know?
entries.source_text: I dunno. Why I come? You know?

entries.text: 我不知道。我为什么来这？你知道吗？
entries.source_text: 我不知道。我为什么来这？你知道吗？

entries.text: How dare you enter my sanctuary with a weapon in your hand! Oaf! Get out!
entries.source_text: How dare you enter my sanctuary with a weapon in your hand! Oaf! Get out!

entries.text: 你怎敢拿着武器来我的圣地？啊！滚出去！
entries.source_text: 你怎敢拿着武器来我的圣地？啊！滚出去！

entries.text: Who do you think you are, entering my sanctum with a drawn weapon. Get out!
entries.source_text: Who do you think you are, entering my sanctum with a drawn weapon. Get out!

entries.text: 你以为你是谁，居然敢拿着武器进入我的圣地。滚出去！
entries.source_text: 你以为你是谁，居然敢拿着武器进入我的圣地。滚出去！

entries.text: Forgive me, sir. But the forces of darkness are everywhere, and one never knows when you must defend yourself.
entries.source_text: Forgive me, sir. But the forces of darkness are everywhere, and one never knows when you must defend yourself.

entries.text: 原谅我，先生。但是黑暗的原力无处不在，一个人从来不会知道什么时候就会遭遇敌人。
entries.source_text: 原谅我，先生。但是黑暗的原力无处不在，一个人从来不会知道什么时候就会遭遇敌人。

entries.source_text: I seek the guidance of the Cathedral.

entries.text: 我寻求大教堂的引导。
entries.source_text: 我寻求大教堂的引导。

entries.source_text: 我来这是为了和你谈谈虐待孩子的问题。

entries.source_text: 我只是想谈谈。

entries.text: 你这个棒子很帅啊！这就是别人为什么叫你拉舍尔的原因吗？
entries.source_text: 你这个棒子很帅啊！这就是别人为什么叫你拉舍尔的原因吗？

entries.text: 你不喜欢我用武器对着你。你会憎恨我将要做的事！
entries.source_text: 你不喜欢我用武器对着你。你会憎恨我将要做的事！

entries.text: Out? Which way out?
entries.source_text: Out? Which way out?

entries.text: 出去？从哪出去？
entries.source_text: 出去？从哪出去？

entries.text: My quarters are not open to those who have not been consecrated. I must ask you to leave at once.
entries.source_text: My quarters are not open to those who have not been consecrated. I must ask you to leave at once.

entries.text: 我的地方不对那些还没向神奉献的人开放。我必须让你马上离开。
entries.source_text: 我的地方不对那些还没向神奉献的人开放。我必须让你马上离开。

entries.text: Forgive my intrusion, but I have important questions.
entries.source_text: Forgive my intrusion, but I have important questions.

entries.text: 原谅我的冒失，但是我有重要的问题。
entries.source_text: 原谅我的冒失，但是我有重要的问题。

entries.text: 我来这是为了和你谈谈虐待孩子的问题。
entries.source_text: 我来这是为了和你谈谈虐待孩子的问题。

entries.text: I wanted to ask you about consecration.
entries.source_text: I wanted to ask you about consecration.

entries.text: 我想问你关于向神奉献的事情。
entries.source_text: 我想问你关于向神奉献的事情。

entries.text: 你这个棒子很帅啊！这就是别人为什么叫你拉舍尔的原因吗？
entries.source_text: 你这个棒子很帅啊！这就是别人为什么叫你拉舍尔的原因吗？

entries.text: 这个地方看起来不够神圣。我还没在这杀过人呢。
entries.source_text: 这个地方看起来不够神圣。我还没在这杀过人呢。

entries.text: 你这个蠢货！我已经得到了相当多的奉献！
entries.source_text: 你这个蠢货！我已经得到了相当多的奉献！

entries.text: That is a privilege reserved for only the most faithful servants. Only baptism is a higher honor.
entries.source_text: That is a privilege reserved for only the most faithful servants. Only baptism is a higher honor.

entries.text: 那是一个只为最忠诚的仆人所保留的特权。只有洗礼才是一个更高的荣誉。
entries.source_text: 那是一个只为最忠诚的仆人所保留的特权。只有洗礼才是一个更高的荣誉。

entries.text: And how does one earn baptism?
entries.source_text: And how does one earn baptism?

entries.text: 那么一个人怎样才能获得洗礼呢？
entries.source_text: 那么一个人怎样才能获得洗礼呢？

entries.text: I suppose you are teaching the children and preparing them for baptism.
entries.source_text: I suppose you are teaching the children and preparing them for baptism.

entries.text: 你在教育教徒并且为他们准备洗礼？
entries.source_text: 你在教育教徒并且为他们准备洗礼？

entries.text: Can you help me to be baptized?
entries.source_text: Can you help me to be baptized?

entries.text: 你能帮我让我受洗礼吗？
entries.source_text: 你能帮我让我受洗礼吗？

entries.text: Wow! You must be special!
entries.source_text: Wow! You must be special!

entries.text: 喔！你一定很特别！
entries.source_text: 喔！你一定很特别！

entries.text: 当你死了的时候那些狗屁特权一文不值。
entries.source_text: 当你死了的时候那些狗屁特权一文不值。

entries.text: I see no reason to converse with a fool. Away with you.
entries.source_text: I see no reason to converse with a fool. Away with you.

entries.text: 我没有理由和一个蠢货交谈。你走吧。
entries.source_text: 我没有理由和一个蠢货交谈。你走吧。

entries.text: You should speak to Father Morpheus. He is in the tower, but it is unlikely that the Nightkin will allow you to pass.
entries.source_text: You should speak to Father Morpheus. He is in the tower, but it is unlikely that the Nightkin will allow you to pass.

entries.text: 你应该和墨菲斯神父谈谈。他在塔中，但是夜行团是不太可能让你通过的。
entries.source_text: 你应该和墨菲斯神父谈谈。他在塔中，但是夜行团是不太可能让你通过的。

entries.text: Could you persuade the Nightkin to let me pass?
entries.source_text: Could you persuade the Nightkin to let me pass?

entries.text: 你能说服夜行团让我通过吗？
entries.source_text: 你能说服夜行团让我通过吗？

entries.text: What can you tell me about Morpheus?
entries.source_text: What can you tell me about Morpheus?

entries.text: 你能告诉我关于墨菲斯的事情吗？
entries.source_text: 你能告诉我关于墨菲斯的事情吗？

entries.text: What can you tell me about the Nightkin.
entries.source_text: What can you tell me about the Nightkin.

entries.text: 你能告诉我关于夜行团的事情吗？
entries.source_text: 你能告诉我关于夜行团的事情吗？

entries.text: Thank you, sir.
entries.source_text: Thank you, sir.

entries.text: 谢谢你，先生。
entries.source_text: 谢谢你，先生。

entries.text: I have ways of getting around these sorts of problems.
entries.source_text: I have ways of getting around these sorts of problems.

entries.text: 我有办法搞定这个问题。
entries.source_text: 我有办法搞定这个问题。

entries.text: The rod is a holy instrument, through which I instruct my charges. Pain clears the mind of evil thoughts and allows them to better comprehend the glory of the Master.
entries.source_text: The rod is a holy instrument, through which I instruct my charges. Pain clears the mind of evil thoughts and allows them to better comprehend the glory of the Master.

entries.text: 这个棒是一个神圣的工具，通过它我可以发号施令。痛苦清除头脑中的邪念，并且让头脑充分领悟主教的荣耀。
entries.source_text: 这个棒是一个神圣的工具，通过它我可以发号施令。痛苦清除头脑中的邪念，并且让头脑充分领悟主教的荣耀。

entries.text: 我明白了。这么说主教是个痛苦喽？
entries.source_text: 我明白了。这么说主教是个痛苦喽？

entries.text: That抯 a horrible thing to do to children!
entries.source_text: That抯 a horrible thing to do to children!

entries.text: 对孩子们做那件事太可怕了！
entries.source_text: 对孩子们做那件事太可怕了！

entries.text: Sounds kinky. How about trying some on me?
entries.source_text: Sounds kinky. How about trying some on me?

entries.text: 听起来真怪。在我身上试试怎么样？
entries.source_text: 听起来真怪。在我身上试试怎么样？

entries.text: I instruct the children. It is my duty. All children are wicked beasts. It is my duty to force them into evolve into human beings. Perhaps you have heard that I do not tolerate frivolity. This is true. I want my charges to suffer as much as possible.
entries.source_text: I instruct the children. It is my duty. All children are wicked beasts. It is my duty to force them into evolve into human beings. Perhaps you have heard that I do not tolerate frivolity. This is true. I want my charges to suffer as much as possible.

entries.text: 我教导教徒们。这是我的职责。所有的教徒都是邪恶的野兽。强迫它们进化成人类是我的职责。也许你听说过我不能容忍无聊的琐事。那的确是的。我要我的权力充分地发挥。
entries.source_text: 我教导教徒们。这是我的职责。所有的教徒都是邪恶的野兽。强迫它们进化成人类是我的职责。也许你听说过我不能容忍无聊的琐事。那的确是的。我要我的权力充分地发挥。

entries.text: And are mutants more evolved than human beings?
entries.source_text: And are mutants more evolved than human beings?

entries.text: 那么变种人比人类更进化喽？
entries.source_text: 那么变种人比人类更进化喽？

entries.text: You heartless bastard!
entries.source_text: You heartless bastard!

entries.text: 你这个残酷的杂种！
entries.source_text: 你这个残酷的杂种！

entries.text: You never got laid, did you?
entries.source_text: You never got laid, did you?

entries.text: 你从没做过爱，是不是？
entries.source_text: 你从没做过爱，是不是？

entries.text: Tell me more about your teaching methods.
entries.source_text: Tell me more about your teaching methods.

entries.text: 告诉我更多关于你的教学方法。
entries.source_text: 告诉我更多关于你的教学方法。

entries.text: 那么杀戮的快感呢？那不是被允许的吗？
entries.source_text: 那么杀戮的快感呢？那不是被允许的吗？

entries.text: You filthy brainless abomination! How dare you defile my presence! Get out! Out! Now!
entries.source_text: You filthy brainless abomination! How dare you defile my presence! Get out! Out! Now!

entries.text: 你这个污秽的没有脑子的低能儿！你怎么敢污染我的胜地！滚出去！滚！现在就滚！
entries.source_text: 你这个污秽的没有脑子的低能儿！你怎么敢污染我的胜地！滚出去！滚！现在就滚！

entries.text: You are a woman, and therefore you are always troubled. It is an endemic condition of your breed. Tell me your problem, madam, and I will resolve it for you.
entries.source_text: You are a woman, and therefore you are always troubled. It is an endemic condition of your breed. Tell me your problem, madam, and I will resolve it for you.

entries.text: 你是一个女人，因此你经常困惑。这是你这个族类共有的状况。告诉我你的问题，女士，我将会为你解决它。
entries.source_text: 你是一个女人，因此你经常困惑。这是你这个族类共有的状况。告诉我你的问题，女士，我将会为你解决它。

entries.text: If your heart was not so full of wickedness, sir, you would be at ease. A righteous heart knows no cares. Tell me your problem, but be quick!
entries.source_text: If your heart was not so full of wickedness, sir, you would be at ease. A righteous heart knows no cares. Tell me your problem, but be quick!

entries.text: 如果你的心灵不是充满了龌龊的事，先生，你会感到安逸。一个正义的心灵是无所顾及的。告诉我你的问题！快点！
entries.source_text: 如果你的心灵不是充满了龌龊的事，先生，你会感到安逸。一个正义的心灵是无所顾及的。告诉我你的问题！快点！

entries.text: Tell me how to attain righteousness!
entries.source_text: Tell me how to attain righteousness!

entries.text: 告诉我如何达到正义！
entries.source_text: 告诉我如何达到正义！

entries.text: I want to know more about the Cathedral.
entries.source_text: I want to know more about the Cathedral.

entries.text: 我想知道关于大教堂更多的事情。
entries.source_text: 我想知道关于大教堂更多的事情。

entries.text: I want to know about the Master.
entries.source_text: I want to know about the Master.

entries.text: 我想知道关于主教的事情。
entries.source_text: 我想知道关于主教的事情。

entries.text: 你还活着。这就是我的问题！你这个狗娘养的！
entries.source_text: 你还活着。这就是我的问题！你这个狗娘养的！

entries.text: 学会像拥抱密友一样拥抱痛苦，因为痛苦是宇宙中最有益的力量。打碎你自己，直到你不再以个体的形式存在，然后把你自己改造成主教的工具。这就是你所有问题的解决办法。
entries.source_text: 学会像拥抱密友一样拥抱痛苦，因为痛苦是宇宙中最有益的力量。打碎你自己，直到你不再以个体的形式存在，然后把你自己改造成主教的工具。这就是你所有问题的解决办法。

entries.text: So where can I find the most pain?
entries.source_text: So where can I find the most pain?

entries.text: 那么我在哪里能找到最大的痛苦呢？
entries.source_text: 那么我在哪里能找到最大的痛苦呢？

entries.text: 耶！要我承受足够多的脑损伤就因为我要加入丧尸的礼拜！做梦去吧，伙计！
entries.source_text: 耶！要我承受足够多的脑损伤就因为我要加入丧尸的礼拜！做梦去吧，伙计！

entries.text: I would never have thought of that!
entries.source_text: I would never have thought of that!

entries.text: 我真希望我没听过这个！
entries.source_text: 我真希望我没听过这个！

entries.text: It is? That sucks, pal!
entries.source_text: It is? That sucks, pal!

entries.text: 是这样的？真他妈愚蠢，伙计！
entries.source_text: 是这样的？真他妈愚蠢，伙计！

entries.text: I already embrace pain. I just like to share it with my friends.
entries.source_text: I already embrace pain. I just like to share it with my friends.

entries.text: 我已经拥抱痛苦了。我只想和我的朋友一起分享它。
entries.source_text: 我已经拥抱痛苦了。我只想和我的朋友一起分享它。

entries.text: Beasts chatter without meaning. Human beings think first, and then they talk. You must evolve into a human being before I will wish to speak you. Be gone.
entries.source_text: Beasts chatter without meaning. Human beings think first, and then they talk. You must evolve into a human being before I will wish to speak you. Be gone.

entries.text: 野兽毫无意义地嘶吼。人类先思考，然后开口。在我愿意和你说话前你必须进化成人类。走吧。
entries.source_text: 野兽毫无意义地嘶吼。人类先思考，然后开口。在我愿意和你说话前你必须进化成人类。走吧。

entries.text: Your words are true. Very well, I will help you. But be quick.
entries.source_text: Your words are true. Very well, I will help you. But be quick.

entries.text: 你的话是真诚的。非常好，我将帮助你。但是抓紧时间。
entries.source_text: 你的话是真诚的。非常好，我将帮助你。但是抓紧时间。

entries.text: I must see Father Morpheus on an urgent matter.
entries.source_text: I must see Father Morpheus on an urgent matter.

entries.text: 我有要事必须见墨菲斯神父。
entries.source_text: 我有要事必须见墨菲斯神父。

entries.text: Tell me about the Cathedral.
entries.source_text: Tell me about the Cathedral.

entries.text: 告诉我关于大教堂的事。
entries.source_text: 告诉我关于大教堂的事。

entries.text: I was wondering where I could find the Master.
entries.source_text: I was wondering where I could find the Master.

entries.text: 我不知道在哪能找到主教。
entries.source_text: 我不知道在哪能找到主教。

entries.text: I was wondering about the Children.
entries.source_text: I was wondering about the Children.

entries.text: 我正对大教堂教徒感到纳闷。
entries.source_text: 我正对大教堂教徒感到纳闷。

entries.text: The only thing I know that抯 quick is Death.
entries.source_text: The only thing I know that抯 quick is Death.

entries.text: 我唯一知道的如此快速的事情就是死亡。
entries.source_text: 我唯一知道的如此快速的事情就是死亡。

entries.text: 有一个时刻，你必须自己发现生活的真谛，这个时刻就是现在。离去吧！
entries.source_text: 有一个时刻，你必须自己发现生活的真谛，这个时刻就是现在。离去吧！

entries.text: That is not my duty. Now begone.
entries.source_text: That is not my duty. Now begone.

entries.text: 那不是我的职责。现在离开吧。
entries.source_text: 那不是我的职责。现在离开吧。

entries.text: By the endurance of pain, by the acquisition of wisdom, and the performance of service. Pain is knowledge, Wisdom is obedience, and Service is courage.
entries.source_text: By the endurance of pain, by the acquisition of wisdom, and the performance of service. Pain is knowledge, Wisdom is obedience, and Service is courage.

entries.text: 通过对痛苦的忍耐，通过对智慧的获得，还有对效劳的体验。痛苦是知识，智慧是顺从，效劳是勇气。
entries.source_text: 通过对痛苦的忍耐，通过对智慧的获得，还有对效劳的体验。痛苦是知识，智慧是顺从，效劳是勇气。

entries.text: You must reject the Light that nearly destroyed us all, and pledge yourself to the Darkness in which all are equal. Now that I have told you this thing, go seek it. Seek the Master and his wisdom.
entries.source_text: You must reject the Light that nearly destroyed us all, and pledge yourself to the Darkness in which all are equal. Now that I have told you this thing, go seek it. Seek the Master and his wisdom.

entries.text: 你必须拒绝那在附近毁灭我们全部的光芒，把你自己投入到万物平等的黑暗中。现在我已经告诉了你这件事，去寻找它吧。寻找主教和他的智慧。
entries.source_text: 你必须拒绝那在附近毁灭我们全部的光芒，把你自己投入到万物平等的黑暗中。现在我已经告诉了你这件事，去寻找它吧。寻找主教和他的智慧。

entries.text: I have not consulted him, but I am certain he is pleased with the righteous souls I have brought him. It is difficult work, but I do it well. Unfortunately, it is also quite time consuming, which is why I must order to you to leave right now.
entries.source_text: I have not consulted him, but I am certain he is pleased with the righteous souls I have brought him. It is difficult work, but I do it well. Unfortunately, it is also quite time consuming, which is why I must order to you to leave right now.

entries.text: 我还没有向他讨教，但是我确信他对我带给他的那个正义的灵魂很满意。那是件困难的工作，但是我做得不错。不幸的是，它需要花很多的时间，这就是我为什么要你现在就去的原因。
entries.source_text: 我还没有向他讨教，但是我确信他对我带给他的那个正义的灵魂很满意。那是件困难的工作，但是我做得不错。不幸的是，它需要花很多的时间，这就是我为什么要你现在就去的原因。

entries.text: 恶魔的嘴里有个谄媚的舌头！像你一样的恶魔！在我眼前消失！
entries.source_text: 恶魔的嘴里有个谄媚的舌头！像你一样的恶魔！在我眼前消失！

entries.text: You foul mouthed beast! Begone! Learn some manners before you return.
entries.source_text: You foul mouthed beast! Begone! Learn some manners before you return.

entries.text: 你这个满嘴污言秽语的禽兽！走吧！学点礼貌再回来。
entries.source_text: 你这个满嘴污言秽语的禽兽！走吧！学点礼貌再回来。

entries.text: A reasonable request. Take this symbol. Show it to the Nightkin when you wish to pass.
entries.source_text: A reasonable request. Take this symbol. Show it to the Nightkin when you wish to pass.

entries.text: 一个合理的要求。拿着这个标志。当你想通过的时候把它给夜行团看。
entries.source_text: 一个合理的要求。拿着这个标志。当你想通过的时候把它给夜行团看。

entries.text: I cannot help you with that. Begone.
entries.source_text: I cannot help you with that. Begone.

entries.text: 我不能帮你做那个。离去吧。
entries.source_text: 我不能帮你做那个。离去吧。

entries.text: 他是我们的领导者。他是最遵循主教忠告的人，而且他明白主教的许多意图。这就是全部吗？
entries.source_text: 他是我们的领导者。他是最遵循主教忠告的人，而且他明白主教的许多意图。这就是全部吗？

entries.text: Could you persuade the Nightkin to let me pass?
entries.source_text: Could you persuade the Nightkin to let me pass?

entries.text: 你能说服夜行团让我通过吗？
entries.source_text: 你能说服夜行团让我通过吗？

entries.text: Tell me more about Morpheus?
entries.source_text: Tell me more about Morpheus?

entries.text: 告诉我更多关于墨菲斯的事？
entries.source_text: 告诉我更多关于墨菲斯的事？

entries.text: What can you tell me about the Nightkin?
entries.source_text: What can you tell me about the Nightkin?

entries.text: 你能告诉我关于夜行团的事情吗？
entries.source_text: 你能告诉我关于夜行团的事情吗？

entries.text: Thank you, sir.
entries.source_text: Thank you, sir.

entries.text: 谢谢你，先生。
entries.source_text: 谢谢你，先生。

entries.text: So why do you follow this Morpheus bozo?
entries.source_text: So why do you follow this Morpheus bozo?

entries.text: 那么你为什么要跟随墨菲斯这家伙？
entries.source_text: 那么你为什么要跟随墨菲斯这家伙？

entries.text: They serve the Master. They bring the pain of healing to the world. Angels in the Night, who redeem the world by bloodshed. Curiosity is a foolhardy emotion, but doubly so when it comes to the Nightkin. That is your only warning. I have much to do now. Away with you.
entries.source_text: They serve the Master. They bring the pain of healing to the world. Angels in the Night, who redeem the world by bloodshed. Curiosity is a foolhardy emotion, but doubly so when it comes to the Nightkin. That is your only warning. I have much to do now. Away with you.

entries.text: 他们为教主效劳。他们带来用来拯救世界的痛苦。夜里的天使，用流血救赎世界。好奇是一种卤莽的情绪，对夜行团的好奇心更是大大地如此。那是对你唯一的警告。我现在有许多事情要做。你走吧。
entries.source_text: 他们为教主效劳。他们带来用来拯救世界的痛苦。夜里的天使，用流血救赎世界。好奇是一种卤莽的情绪，对夜行团的好奇心更是大大地如此。那是对你唯一的警告。我现在有许多事情要做。你走吧。

entries.text: Your courtesy does you credit. Perhaps you are worthy to talk with Morpheus. If the Nightkin stops you, show them this symbol. Now, away with you!
entries.source_text: Your courtesy does you credit. Perhaps you are worthy to talk with Morpheus. If the Nightkin stops you, show them this symbol. Now, away with you!

entries.text: 你的礼貌令你让人尊重。也许你是值得和墨菲斯交谈的。如果夜行团阻止你，给他们看这个标志。现在你走吧！
entries.source_text: 你的礼貌令你让人尊重。也许你是值得和墨菲斯交谈的。如果夜行团阻止你，给他们看这个标志。现在你走吧！

entries.text: You are a fool if you think petty subterfuge will defeat the Nightkin. Get out of here!
entries.source_text: You are a fool if you think petty subterfuge will defeat the Nightkin. Get out of here!

entries.text: 如果你认为用粗鄙的借口就能说服夜行团，那你真是个蠢货。滚出去！
entries.source_text: 如果你认为用粗鄙的借口就能说服夜行团，那你真是个蠢货。滚出去！

entries.text: Decadence and ease prevents evolution, evolution that is necessary for survival in a harsh world. Fortunately, I am a hard man who cares nothing for seductive pleasures. I see that you disagree with me. I do not care about your opinion. Get out of here!
entries.source_text: Decadence and ease prevents evolution, evolution that is necessary for survival in a harsh world. Fortunately, I am a hard man who cares nothing for seductive pleasures. I see that you disagree with me. I do not care about your opinion. Get out of here!

entries.text: 腐败和安乐阻止发展，发展对在严酷的世界中幸存是必要的。幸运的是，我是一个对充满诱惑的事物漠不关心的硬汉子。我明白你不同意我的想法。我不在乎你的观点。滚出去吧！
entries.source_text: 腐败和安乐阻止发展，发展对在严酷的世界中幸存是必要的。幸运的是，我是一个对充满诱惑的事物漠不关心的硬汉子。我明白你不同意我的想法。我不在乎你的观点。滚出去吧！

entries.text: Mutation is nothing to fear. Every birth is a mutation of our parents?DNA. We are all mutants. The only thing that matters is that the mutant is guided on a moral and productive path. This is my job. And this also ends this discussion. Leave me now.
entries.source_text: Mutation is nothing to fear. Every birth is a mutation of our parents?DNA. We are all mutants. The only thing that matters is that the mutant is guided on a moral and productive path. This is my job. And this also ends this discussion. Leave me now.

entries.text: 变异是不值得害怕的。每个新生儿不都是其双亲的变异吗？DNA。我们都是变种人。唯一有影响的事是在道德上，还有那令其多产的做法。这是我的工作。我说的话应该能结束我们的讨论了。现在离开我吧。
entries.source_text: 变异是不值得害怕的。每个新生儿不都是其双亲的变异吗？DNA。我们都是变种人。唯一有影响的事是在道德上，还有那令其多产的做法。这是我的工作。我说的话应该能结束我们的讨论了。现在离开我吧。

entries.text: I deal out pain. If the animal is worthy and can learn from it, it evolves into a righteous soul. If it does not, it does not deserve to exist. On rare occasions, the animal is removed the genetic pool, although not as often as I would like. This happens more often with failed grown animals.
entries.source_text: I deal out pain. If the animal is worthy and can learn from it, it evolves into a righteous soul. If it does not, it does not deserve to exist. On rare occasions, the animal is removed the genetic pool, although not as often as I would like. This happens more often with failed grown animals.

entries.text: 我使之受苦。如果那些动物有价值并且能从中学习，那么它们也能进化成正义的灵魂。如果它们不能，它们就不应该存在。不过在极为罕见的情况下，虽然我也不想，但一些动物会被移出基因库。这种事情多发生在实验失败的成年动物身上。

entries.text: And the Master approves of the teaching methods?
entries.source_text: And the Master approves of the teaching methods?

entries.text: 那么主教认可这种教学方法吗？
entries.source_text: 那么主教认可这种教学方法吗？

entries.text: 你是个怪物！
entries.source_text: 你是个怪物！

entries.text: I think I抣l leave you now.
entries.source_text: I think I抣l leave you now.

entries.text: 我想我现在应该走了。
entries.source_text: 我想我现在应该走了。

entries.text: Do you teach adults?
entries.source_text: Do you teach adults?

entries.text: 你教导成人吗？
entries.source_text: 你教导成人吗？

entries.text: Grown animals?
entries.source_text: Grown animals?

entries.text: 成年的动物？
entries.source_text: 成年的动物？

entries.text: Hey, I can remove them for you! No one else needs to know!
entries.source_text: Hey, I can remove them for you! No one else needs to know!

entries.text: 嘿，我能为你改动它们！不必让其他人知道！
entries.source_text: 嘿，我能为你改动它们！不必让其他人知道！

entries.text: You are an evil girl. You would do well to tread carefully here. The Nightkin do not enjoy rivals. Now begone!
entries.source_text: You are an evil girl. You would do well to tread carefully here. The Nightkin do not enjoy rivals. Now begone!

entries.text: 你是个邪恶的女人。你在这里要小心点。夜行团不喜欢抬杠的人。现在，去吧！
entries.source_text: 你是个邪恶的女人。你在这里要小心点。夜行团不喜欢抬杠的人。现在，去吧！

entries.text: You are an evil man. You would do well to tread carefully here. The Nightkin do not enjoy rivals. Now begone!
entries.source_text: You are an evil man. You would do well to tread carefully here. The Nightkin do not enjoy rivals. Now begone!

entries.text: 你是个邪恶的人。你在这里要小心点。夜行团不喜欢抬杠的人。现在，去吧！
entries.source_text: 你是个邪恶的人。你在这里要小心点。夜行团不喜欢抬杠的人。现在，去吧！

entries.text: 正义通过挣扎，创伤和恢复获得。我们是动物，我们必须被一直折磨直到我们毫不犹豫地接受主教的真理。现在你已经听到了真理，用你充满经验的肉身去寻找它。离开这里。
entries.source_text: 正义通过挣扎，创伤和恢复获得。我们是动物，我们必须被一直折磨直到我们毫不犹豫地接受主教的真理。现在你已经听到了真理，用你充满经验的肉身去寻找它。离开这里。

entries.text: Your tongue is a wicked thing that is beyond redemption. Get out of my sight!
entries.source_text: Your tongue is a wicked thing that is beyond redemption. Get out of my sight!

entries.text: 你的污言秽语使情况无法补救。滚出我的视线！
entries.source_text: 你的污言秽语使情况无法补救。滚出我的视线！

entries.text: The Cathedral teaches many things which an undisciplined mind is incapable of comprehending. Now I have other duties to perform. Away with you!
entries.source_text: The Cathedral teaches many things which an undisciplined mind is incapable of comprehending. Now I have other duties to perform. Away with you!

entries.text: 大教堂教导人们许多东西，这些是不安分的头脑无法充分理解的。现在，我有其他工作要做。你走吧！
entries.source_text: 大教堂教导人们许多东西，这些是不安分的头脑无法充分理解的。现在，我有其他工作要做。你走吧！

entries.text: As do I. It appears we have many things in common, but unfortunately, you irritate me beyond my ability to tolerate. Get out of here. Now.
entries.source_text: As do I. It appears we have many things in common, but unfortunately, you irritate me beyond my ability to tolerate. Get out of here. Now.

entries.text: 我也是。看起来我们已经有很多共同的地方了，但不幸的是，你的挑衅超过了我忍耐的极限。现在从这滚蛋吧。
entries.source_text: 我也是。看起来我们已经有很多共同的地方了，但不幸的是，你的挑衅超过了我忍耐的极限。现在从这滚蛋吧。

entries.text: It is not my place to judge. You must persuade the Nightkin. Good luck. You will need it.
entries.source_text: It is not my place to judge. You must persuade the Nightkin. Good luck. You will need it.

entries.text: 这不是我能决定的。你必须说服夜行团。祝你好运。你会需要它的。
entries.source_text: 这不是我能决定的。你必须说服夜行团。祝你好运。你会需要它的。

entries.text: The Cathedral is a sanctuary for the human race. When the apocalypse fell on this foul city, the Cathedral was spared, which allowed for the birth of the Master. Thus a healing darkness emerged from a terrible light.
entries.source_text: The Cathedral is a sanctuary for the human race. When the apocalypse fell on this foul city, the Cathedral was spared, which allowed for the birth of the Master. Thus a healing darkness emerged from a terrible light.

entries.text: 大教堂是人类这个种族的圣地。当启示录中的灾难降临在这个污秽的城市的时候，大教堂被分隔开了。这使得主教得以诞生。治疗创伤的黑暗从可怕的光明中浮现。
entries.source_text: 大教堂是人类这个种族的圣地。当启示录中的灾难降临在这个污秽的城市的时候，大教堂被分隔开了。这使得主教得以诞生。治疗创伤的黑暗从可怕的光明中浮现。

entries.text: When I came, I saw this place lacked a moral center, and so I have endeavored to administer teaching pain to a place once consumed with idle pleasure. That is all you need to know.
entries.source_text: When I came, I saw this place lacked a moral center, and so I have endeavored to administer teaching pain to a place once consumed with idle pleasure. That is all you need to know.

entries.text: 当我到来的时候，我发现这个地方缺少一个道德的核心，所以我努力去教导，把痛苦播撒到一个曾经沉浸于散漫享乐的地方。这就是你需要知道的所有事情。
entries.source_text: 当我到来的时候，我发现这个地方缺少一个道德的核心，所以我努力去教导，把痛苦播撒到一个曾经沉浸于散漫享乐的地方。这就是你需要知道的所有事情。

entries.text: It is said the Master waits below, in the Darkness, for the Light above betrayed Mankind and nearly destroyed us. But many bless the Light, for they say it birthed the Master.
entries.source_text: It is said the Master waits below, in the Darkness, for the Light above betrayed Mankind and nearly destroyed us. But many bless the Light, for they say it birthed the Master.

entries.text: 据说主教在下面等待，呆在黑暗中，因为上面的光明背叛了人类并且几乎毁灭了我们。但是赞美光明吧，因为人们说是它使主教诞生。
entries.source_text: 据说主教在下面等待，呆在黑暗中，因为上面的光明背叛了人类并且几乎毁灭了我们。但是赞美光明吧，因为人们说是它使主教诞生。

entries.text: I do not know these things with certainty, and I have never had the privilege to see him. Now if you will excuse me, I have work to do.
entries.source_text: I do not know these things with certainty, and I have never had the privilege to see him. Now if you will excuse me, I have work to do.

entries.text: 我不是很清楚，而且我从来没有权利去见他。现在，希望得到你的谅解，我要去做我的工作了。
entries.source_text: 我不是很清楚，而且我从来没有权利去见他。现在，希望得到你的谅解，我要去做我的工作了。

entries.text: You were not particularly welcome here in the first place. Good riddance to you.
entries.source_text: You were not particularly welcome here in the first place. Good riddance to you.

entries.text: 你在这是最不受欢迎的。你离开是件着实的好事。
entries.source_text: 你在这是最不受欢迎的。你离开是件着实的好事。

entries.text: Once I did, but many of methods were abandoned in favor of the loud noises you hear in the Auditorium amphitheater. It is a source of bitterness for me. Fortunately, I can still instruct the children. Now if you will excuse me, I have to prepare for their lessons.

entries.text: 我做过，但是许多方法都被废除了因为它们使你在礼堂听见许多响亮的噪音。这是一个我痛苦的来源。幸运的是，我仍然能知道教徒们。现在，希望得到你的谅解，我要去准备他们的课程了。

entries.text: Uh?it is of course, a rare event, and the animal is given every chance to evolve. Now leave here! Leave here at once!
entries.source_text: Uh?it is of course, a rare event, and the animal is given every chance to evolve. Now leave here! Leave here at once!

entries.text: 呃？它当然是，一个罕见的事件，并且这个动物被给予了许多进化的机会。现在离开这里！马上离开！
entries.source_text: 呃？它当然是，一个罕见的事件，并且这个动物被给予了许多进化的机会。现在离开这里！马上离开！
